items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: And the only major company that I went with that was under bonds was when I went to Joe Glazer.

ctx.x: Yeah, you would deal with one man?

One man. How much territory? The man that first picked me up was Bernard Galway. And I had him, not only was his name, but Rabinowitz. And then finally this Al Travis that was the biggest crook in the world. And then the next biggest crook was this one that I picked up here, Chauncey Highland, on the revision of my band. Those were crooks. They weren't under bondage like the big companies are now. And the only major company that I went with that was under bonds was when I went to Joe Glazer. See, Glazer wanted me…

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: when Joe Glazer took me under his wing, the reason why I left him was because he was holding out for big guarantees from a band

ctx.x: Yes, different places. Did you travel much?

Well, we traveled every night for almost ten years. We covered 38 states. We covered most every city in every state. You take the state of Texas, which is the largest state in the United States. We covered four corners of Texas. It's not a city in the state that we even far west Texas, a little bit of towns like Pampa. We played those towns, Odessa, before they were ever brought up to in population like they are now. We didn't miss any towns. In Louisiana, we found backwards that we didn't even know existed in…
What year would this be then, Don?
